name: competing_outlets_v1
status: FROZEN before any reduced-vs-reference run. Idealised controlled problems, not a real glacier and not a forecast.

physics_shared_by_both_models.heat_transfer: Dittus-Boelter Nu = 0.023 Re^0.8 Pr^0.3 times nu_factor (default 1)
physics_shared_by_both_models.wall_partition: equal heat flux on the wetted perimeter; wall share spread over the full bank height
physics_shared_by_both_models.note: These closures are shared on purpose, so the comparison measures the reduction (quasi-steady edges, no channel storage, well-mixed edges, station-based geometry, macro-step splitting), NOT the closures. They are tested only by sensitivity, not validated.

terrain_rule: bed z(x) = z_sill for x <= crest_length, then z_sill - slope (x - crest_length); both models sample this one function
reference_estimate: Richardson extrapolation of the 200 and 400 cell results assuming first order (scheme is first order in space); uncertainty = |400 - extrapolated|

event_times: t_end_act2: last time Q_R2 > 0.01 I (None if active at the end)
t_dom2: first time Q_R2 > Q_R1 (None if never)
state: sill lowering of each route at the end
outlet discharge series of each route
metrics.cost: single-thread wall-clock seconds (JIT already compiled); also number of time steps / RHS evaluations

interpretation_limits: Agreement is shown only for these scenarios and shared closures; it is not a validation of the physics and not a forecast.
